records.text: Victor Marx told Corby Hall that SIG Sauer and Daniel Horner were discussing FoldAR's acquisition and that Horner had tested the rifle and approved SIG's involvement.
records.speaker: Victor Marx

appearances.snippet: And he tells me that SIG ... Sauer is going to be involved in this acquisition. ... So he tells me that SIG Sauer is involved. He tells me that Daniel Horner got one of my FoldARs—he’s the top shooter in the world who shoots for SIG. He got a FoldAR, and he’s given the thumbs-up to Victor (Victor Marx), who Victor (Victor Marx) represented he had a personal relationship with.

As part of this, Mr. Marx (Victor Marx) revealed that he was discussing the acquisition with SIG Sauer and their top shooter, Daniel Horner, who Mr. ... Marx stated had received and tested the FoldAR and had given the thumbs-up for SIG's involvement.

verification.notes: Hall later repeated that Marx invoked SIG Sauer and Daniel Horner during acquisition talks. No statement from SIG Sauer or Horner, acquisition record, test record, or other independent evidence was found to confirm Marx representations. Unable to verify the private claim.
